books.title: I Kissed Shara Wheeler
books.author: Casey McQuiston
books.description: A sharp, funny, and emotionally layered queer mystery-romance set in a conservative Southern high school, where rivals, secrets, and unexpected alliances collide.

books.title: American Royals
books.author: Katharine McGee
books.description: An addictive alternate-history series imagining America with a royal family, blending political intrigue, romance, and celebrity culture.

books.title: Furia
books.author: Yamile Saied Méndez

books.author: Tiffany D. Jackson
books.description: A chilling, emotionally devastating mystery about a missing girl—and the systems that fail to notice when Black girls disappear.

books.title: Stay Gold
